free_text_notes.physician_note: 81-year-old woman with GERD, hypertension, admitted 6/8 with AECOPD with hypercapnic respiratory failure, now resolved. Completed 5 days of systemic steroids; wheeze resolved. 6/15 10:20: New wheeze and tachycardia (118) overnight; not at discharge threshold. A routine delirium screening was performed each morning as per standard protocol. The patient scored zero on every assessment and showed no signs of confusion.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Ambulated in hallway with nephew present. 6/14 15:00: Theophylline stopped (was 300 mg twice daily) this morning. Reviewed with patient and nephew at 15:00; teach-back correct.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and nephew to review the discharge plan. Patient worried about the cost of the new medication. PT recommends assistance with all transfers for now.
